profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with expertise in C and C++ on VxWorks and Linux platforms.

Specialties: C, C++, VxWorks, Linux

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Member of the engineering team responsible for developing new features for the HD STB platforms.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for developing new innovative features for wireless mesh products based on VxWorks platform using C and C++.
- Developed SNMP mibs and supporting source code for the wireless device.
- Developed new features for VLANs and multiple ssid’s.
- Modified tcpdump source code to create tools for analyzing network behavior.
- Ported 802.11i security related source code from main stream vendor into existing source code.
- Wrote batch scripts to perform various automated functions and feature testing.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Lead person involved in design and development of Global Shipping System and Enterprise Management System for the company. Work through the entire software development life cycle. Responsibilities include collecting user requirements, creating UML diagrams for the project, design and development.
- Worked on collecting VoIP protocol sessions using protocol analyzer for Interoperability certification.
